product.title: Norix Evvolve Durable Table
product.body_html:
The Norix Evvolve Table combines a modern design aesthetic with the extreme safety and durability standards of Norix products. Ribbed design details provide a neutral and comforting repetitive pattern while avoiding perceived two-dimensional imagery. The tapered base creates increased stability when ballasted and allows for easy cleaning.

  • Tabletop sizes 36", 42", or 48" round or 36", 42" square
  • Fabrication and Material:
    • Base: Rotationally-molded polyethylene with lightly textured, maintenance-free surface which allows for easy cleaning. Specially formulated, high-impact polyethylene with ultraviolet light stabilizers (to reduce fading). Chemically resistant to blood, vinegar, urine, feces, salt solution and chlorine solution. Premium TruColor polymer is fully compounded for superior color consistency and durability.
    • Standard Top: Premium M3 Grade, 45 lb. density particle board table top core is sandwiched between 1/8" thick hardboard and faced with special 0.05” thick high pressure laminate for superior quality and long term durability. Molded edge is radiused for safety and comfort, pressure fused to the top, rendering it firmly attached and highly sanitary. Embedded T-nuts secure top to base with tight steel to steel connection for maximum long term reliability. Robust 1.5" thick edge profile.
    • DuoForm Top: Specially formulated, high-impact polyethylene layers with ultraviolet light stabilizers are permanently fused to offer enhanced strength and long-term durability. The molded, maintenance-free surface is easy to clean and chemically resistant to blood, vinegar, urine, feces, salt solution and chlorine solution. Premium TruColor polymer is fully compounded for superior color consistency and durability. The top and base are fastened using rivnuts to establish a highly secure, steel-to-steel connection. Precision-crafted 1.5” (3.8 cm) thick edge profile.  Optional Concealment Plate (for indoor use only).
  • Top and edge color choices for standard top:
    • Black edge + Titanium Evolve top
    • Wild Cherry edge + Wild Cherry top
    • Kensington Maple edge + Kensington Maple top
    • Asian Sun edge + Asian Sun top
    • Montana Walnut edge + Montana Walnut top
    • Graham Cracker edge + Palisades Oak top
    • HM Innertone Light edge + Calcutta Marble top
    • Black edge + Black Alicante top
    • Black edge + Titanium Evolve Game Top
  • Base type: Molded
  • Base colors: Twilight, Cove, Dove, Sienna, Raven
  • Models:
    • EV3600 - Standard Top, 36" diameter x 31.1"H, 74 lbs
    • EV3636 - Standard Top, 36"L x 36"W x 31.1"H, 85 lbs
    • EV4200 - Standard Top, 42" diameter x 31.1"H, 88 lbs
    • EV4242 - Standard Top, 42"L x 42"W x 31.1"H, 104 lbs
    • EV4242-DF - DuoForm Top, 42"L x 42"W x 31.1"H, 55 lbs
    • EV4800 - Standard Top, 48" diameter x 31.1"H, 106 lbs
  • Ballast weighting required to validate warranty. Recommend 200 lbs (90.7 kg) of dry
    sand or gravel ballast. On site materials not supplied by Norix.
  • Available options: ballasting at factory; bolt-down kit


About Norix Furniture:
Norix Group specializes in providing high quality, intensive-use institutional furniture designed specifically for behavioral health care facilities, hospitals, jails, prisons, detention centers, and other challenging markets. Norix humanizes behavioral and correctional facilities, while building extreme durability and security into each piece of institutional furniture so it stands up to correctional grade use. Norix furniture is as tough as your prison or detention grade environment, yet safe for trustees and staff. Anchortex supplies the complete line of Norix furniture for patient rooms, classrooms, inmate cells, day rooms, lobbies, intake areas, chapels, dining halls, outdoor/recreation, contact visitation and video-visitation areas, as well as public safety furniture for police and fire stations that looks good and stands up to hard use. Norix meets or exceeds testing requirements for intensive-use institutional and detention grade furniture, and the everyday test of use at healthcare and detention institutions by people who don't necessarily have the best interests of the institutional furniture in mind.
